name: Han (Warring States)
alt: Han of the Seven Warring States

predecessors.name: Jin (Chinese state)
predecessors.text: the Cliopatria Han shape without Anyi, Hedong, Xihe and the Luoyang domain, with Yangzhai, Yiyang and Shangdang (the corrected K0)

successors.name: Kingdom of Hán (Eighteen Kingdoms)
successors.text: the Hán kingdom of the Eighteen Kingdoms: Han Cheng, 'southwestern Henan'

ledger.x: 403: the Zhou king recognises Han with Wei and Zhao as marquisates.
376: Han and Zhao divide the last Jin land.
375: Han annexes Zheng and moves its capital to Xinzheng.
375: Han's capital moves from Yangzhai to Xinzheng, Zheng's capital.
366: Cliopatria adds 2 cells of the Zhou royal domain to Han.
350: Cliopatria adds 9 cells of the Zhou royal domain and 1 of Chu to Han.
350: Cliopatria adds 15 cells of Zhao's shape to Han and takes 22 back.
350: Cliopatria passes 22 cells of Han's shape to Zhao.
337: Cliopatria passes 34 cells on Han's western edge to Qin.
265: Qin attacks Han in the north.
262: the Han-Qin fight over Shangdang ends as Shangdang passes to Zhao and Qin turns on Zhao.
247: Cliopatria passes 2 cells of Han's shape to Chu.
208: Zhang Liang persuades Xiang Liang to restore the Hán state and 'Han Cheng, a descendant of the royal family of Hán, was enthroned as King of Hán' (Zhang Liang page, 2026-10-19).
207: Cliopatria's Han row ends and the Hán row (206-204) continues the restored kingdom: 'created by military leader Xiang Yu in 206 BCE', Hán, Han Cheng, 'southwestern Henan'.

wars.name: Battle of Yique
wars.outcome: Qin victory: 'In 293 BC, the states of Han, Wei and East Zhou allied together to attack Qin'; Bai Qi 'defeated the two major states at Yique'.

wars.name: Qin capture of Yiyang
wars.outcome: Qin victory: King Wu defeated the Han army; Yiyang captured in 307.

wars.name: Qin campaign for Shangdang
wars.outcome: Qin took Qinyang (265) and invaded Shangdang (262); the commandery passed to Zhao, which led to Changping (260).

wars.name: Qin's conquest of Han
wars.outcome: Qin victory in 230: Neishi Teng took the capital Xinzheng and King An was captured; Han was the first state Qin conquered.

wars.name: Qin defeat of Wei and Han
wars.outcome: 'In 364 BC, Qin inflicted a major defeat on a combined armies of Wei and Han.'

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line is on any page; Han's frontiers with Wei, Zhao, Chu, Qin and the Zhou domain are approximate throughout, and the corrected shapes mix Cliopatria cells with discs around named places.
